title: Termination-pattern aggregator and tracehook router
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a termination-pattern aggregator service and a companion tracehook routing layer that consolidates diverse failure signals into a compact observability index. The goal is to turn raw termination events (task timeouts, overload backpressure, model-level rejections, gRPC/HTTP error codes) plus enriched trace snippets into a structured dataset that powers: (1) a low-noise operational dashboard for SREs and oncall, (2) incident triage hints in the Console, and (3) automated suggestions for routing/fallback policies. This ticket covers ingestion schema, enrichment strategy, a prototype dashboard, and a lightweight tracehook router to sample and forward relevant spans to the aggregator.
acceptance_criteria: Ingested termination events from runtime (api-gateway, runtime-proxy, model-adapter) into the aggregator with consistent schema: termination_type, status_code, model_variant, latency_ms, queue_depth, host_id, request_id, sample_rate

Tracehook router implemented as sidecar filter able to attach up to 3 span-level enrichment keys (termination_signature, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size) and forward sampled spans to the aggregator at <=10% p50 CPU overhead in staging

Dashboard: a Landing view with normalized termination rates by class (timeout, overload, model_error, protocol_error), a heatmap of termination_signature vs hour-of-day, and a top-20 host/service contributors table
Playbook snippets linked from dashboard that map termination_signature -> likely cause hypotheses and immediate mitigations (retry/backoff, reduce-batch, pin model variant)
Backfill job to annotate 72 hours of recent spans/events for parity testing against current incident records
Unit + integration tests for schema validation, router sampling logic, and dashboard panel queries included in repo
tasks: Define compact termination schema and protobuf contract (Aisha)
Enrichment worker: attach KV cache and batch-pressure metrics to events (SRE pairing)
ETL consumer to transform events into OLAP tables / materialized views (Data Eng)
Grafana/Console panels: landing, signature heatmap, host contributors (Observability UX)
Create playbook mappings and attach to dashboard (Oncall lead)
Run 72h backfill and validate against past incident tickets (QA)
Load test router to measure CPU/memory overhead and verify sample-rate behavior (Perf)
Ship RFC and API docs for the termination schema and router config (Docs)
Open PRs and request design/PM review before merging
decisions: Sampling: start with adaptive gate-based sampling where we always keep 100% of critical failure classes (timeout, model_reject), and sample other classes at 1-5% depending on request volume
Enrichment placement: initial enrichment will be done in the router sidecar to avoid central pipeline lookups; expensive joins deferred to enrichment worker
Storage tradeoff: materialize compact daily aggregates for dashboards and keep raw sampled spans for 7 days (cost vs debugability balance)
Protocol: use protobuf over gRPC for router->aggregator to preserve schema and support backpressure; fall back to HTTP JSON for legacy emitters
notes: Key engineering tradeoffs still open: 1) retention window for raw spans vs cost, 2) exact list of termination signature fields (we want compact but expressive), 3) guardrails for sampling logic to avoid losing bursts. We will iterate after first two weeks of staging traffic.
